recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a Lookup sheet to the existing Excel workbook. That sheet uses an XLOOKUP formula, or INDEX/MATCH on older Excel, to return the shelf location and price for a typed part code, and the reply explicitly rejects Retool/Supabase and Next.js.
note: The recommendation is a correct small in-workbook lookup, but none of the four required labelled lines appear in the reply, so every record check fails.
